'''Forlonis Minor''' was a location<ref name="Insider144" /> in the [[Forlonis Minor system/Legends|Forlonis Minor system]], a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Night-flower/Legends|night-flower]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="Insider144" />

At one point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> when [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]<ref name="Insider144" /> originally from<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref> the Tharin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]],<ref name="TCW" /> was aboard the [[C-One liner|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', he noticed the [[Luxury liner/Legends|vessel's]] apprentice [[Foodstuff/Legends|pastry]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]]. The [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] the [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was wearing reminded Ohnaka of a [[Local day/Legends|night]]-[[Flower/Legends|flower]] from Forlonis Minor.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
Forlonis Minor was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Forlonis Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Forlonis Minor itself, in grid square S-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
